item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Notice that food is easiest to decide well when you're not rushed or running on empty. So plan your next meal now, before hunger makes the choice for you. Include some protein and something fresh, and sit down to eat it without a screen. Eat slowly enough to notice when you're satisfied. Your action: decide what your next meal is, right now, and say it out loud.
